title: Quenched Smoky Chinese Pork Sweet and Sour Jjajangmyeon
description: A smoky, cheesy, brunch-inspired Chinese dish with ground coriander and lamination puff, suitable for a Whole30 diet.

ingredients.name: Granulated Sugar
ingredients.notes: optional for whole30, can be omitted

ingredients.name: Soy Sauce
ingredients.notes: whole30 friendly alternative to traditional soy sauce

instructions: In a large pan over medium-high heat, cook the ground pork until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the ground coriander, granulated sugar, apple cider vinegar, soy sauce, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the lamination puff to the pan and stir-fry until crispy.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 20 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
While the mixture is baking, cook the scallions in a pan with a little bit of oil until softened, then chop them finely and set aside.
Once the mixture is done baking, remove it from the oven and top it with the chopped scallions.
Return the dish to the oven and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the scallions are slightly caramelized.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
